text:
maria-ops: afternoon async — quick audit sweep update: finished host-level SCA for staging, opened vuln ticket CVE-2025-0234 for old redis client. Linked two PRs for remediation. Blocked on prod KMS dry-run: rotation script failing on decrypt in canary. @hao can you take a look? :lock:

hao: digging in now. seeing this in the canary logs:
```
2025-03-04T15:12:03Z ERROR rewrap: decrypt failed: key version not found (v3)
stack: /opt/rotation/rewrap.go:87
```
Looks like the key metadata didn't sync to the host after the version bump.

maria-ops: ugh. That explains it. Also need the IAM policy L4 change approved before we run rotation in prod — pinging @sara for review.

sara: I'll review by EOD. quick Q: does rotation require snapshot re-encryption for backups or will they be re-wrapped automatically?

maria-ops: backups need explicit rewrap, plan is in /docs/kms-rotation.md (internal). we have a one-line script that does it, will paste after.

nick: FYI I'm ready to merge the PR for the audit rules but can hold to coordinate with the rotation window. my suggestion: schedule rotation for Fri 22:00 UTC, estimate 30m for legacy connector rewraps. thoughts? :calendar:

hao: Friday looks good for me, but infra needs to confirm maintenance window. also noticed the canary job shows a flaky test that might be masking rewrap failures — marking as blocker.

sara: ack, blocking calendar for 22:00-22:30 and will notify SRE. I'll approve the IAM change once I confirm the service-account list (posting comment on the PR).

engsec-bot: Automated scan finished: 2 high, 5 medium. High issues tracked in JIRA: SEC-4567, SEC-4568. :warning:

rotations-bot: Dry-run started on staging at 2165432400. Summary: 1/3 hosts failed rewrap. Logs uploaded: gs://redwood-logs/kms-rotations/2165432400.log

maria-ops: thanks — @hao can you ssh to the failing host and try the repro command, then paste the last 10 lines of output? Command: `ssh staging-3 'sudo /opt/rotation/rewrap --verbose'` If you can't get it, I'll escalate to infra. :eyes:

hao: on it, will post output in ~10m.
